item.title: Attorney General Ellison announces Strengthening Rural Maternal Healthcare in Minnesota project
item.description:
Publication Date: October 28, 2026

More than 700K people in Greater Minnesota live in counties without labor and delivery wards, more than 20 percent of Minnesota hospitals have discontinued obstetric services in the last 15 years low rural hospital birth volumes and long drives to deliver babies correlated with complications during delivery
